violation_type.title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level - Follow any restrictions (26 TAC §746.4217(2))
violation_type.short_title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level - Follow any restrictions
violation_type.typical_finding: Based upon the information obtained during the investigation, sufficient evidence was available to support the restrictions issued by the Fire Marshal had not been followed by allowing children under 2-years old to be cared for above ground level in the months of March and April 2024.  CORRECTED - There were no children under 2-years-old being cared for in May 2024.  Procedures have been put in place to ensure children who have not turned 2-years old will not be allowed upstairs.

finding_variants.text: Based upon the information obtained during the investigation, sufficient evidence was available to support the restrictions issued by the Fire Marshal had not been followed by allowing children under 2-years old to be cared for above ground level in the months of March and April 2024. Operation failed to follow restrictions issued by the local fire authority that restricted children above ground level.
Two children under 24 months old were being cared for above ground level.
